formUrl.title: Form URL
formUrl.description: HTTPS address of the form, or demo for the built-in Care team request form. To fill or submit a real form, its owner must opt in by putting form-errand:allow in the form's description, or the form must be on this Actor's allowed list.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Preview: fill and read back, never send
mode.description: Inspect lists the questions. Preview fills the form, reads every value back off the page and returns a digest and a screenshot, without sending. Submit sends only with a confirm and the digest from the preview.

fields.title: Answers
fields.description: List of answers, each {"label": question text, "value": answer, "source": optional note on where the answer came from}. Use a list of strings for checkbox questions and true or false for a single checkbox.

prefill.label: Details
prefill.value: Lunch at the cafe across the street, wheelchair entrance on the side.

confirm.title: The person confirmed the read-back
confirm.description: Submit only. Turn on only after the person heard the read-back and confirmed it.

confirmDigest.title: Digest from the preview
confirmDigest.description: Submit only. The previewDigest the person confirmed. If the page holds anything different now, nothing is sent.

submitButtonText.title: Send button text
submitButtonText.description: Visible name of the form's send button.

confirmationPattern.title: Confirmation text pattern
confirmationPattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression the page must show after sending. If it does not appear, the run reports that it could not confirm.

disclosureText.title: Note added to the answers
disclosureText.description: Appended to one paragraph answer so the recipient knows how the form was sent. Leave empty to turn it off.
disclosureText.default: Sent with an assistive switch after a spoken read-back and a confirm.

disclosureField.title: Question that gets the note
disclosureField.description: Optional. Label of the paragraph question for the note. Defaults to the last paragraph question you fill.

includeScreenshot.title: Return the screenshot inline
includeScreenshot.description: Standby only. Adds the screenshot as base64 to the HTTP response so a dashboard needs no second request.
